senses.definition: To send something through the air from your hand, or to toss it carelessly into a place.

examples.text: Hij wil de bal naar de hond gooien.
examples.translation: He wants to throw the ball to the dog.
examples.emotion: playful and eager, waiting for the dog to run

examples.text: Je kunt dat oude papier in de bak gooien.
examples.translation: You can toss that old paper into the bin.
examples.emotion: casual and matter-of-fact, cleaning up the desk

draftBefore.shortGloss: to throw; to toss; to cast
draftBefore.emotion: energetic and physical, putting your whole arm into the movement

senses.definition: To send something through the air from your hand by moving your arm quickly.

examples.text: Hij wil de bal naar de hond gooien.
examples.translation: He wants to throw the ball to the dog.
examples.emotion: playful and eager, waiting for the dog to run

senses.definition: To put or drop something somewhere quickly and without much care.

examples.text: Je kunt dat oude papier in de bak gooien.
